column_semantics: The schedule has a separate 'Spread Above Index (1)' column and an 'Interest Rate (2)' column. For PIK investments, the interest-rate cell prints the cash coupon followed by a separately labelled PIK component, e.g. '6.70 % cash/ 1.75 % PIK'; the stated interest-rate number is the cash leg and PIK is quoted separately, on top.

rationale: The printed schedule does not present one all-in coupon with a PIK parenthetical. Instead, PIK positions show the cash coupon and PIK percentage as distinct labels inside the interest-rate area, such as '6.70 % cash/ 1.75 % PIK'. Because the PIK component is separately printed and additive to the cash coupon, the filer's stated position-level interest rate means the cash leg only when PIK is present.
